H1 statement links built on track/h-statement: 9926ac4 feat(statements) backend+070+contracts+erasure+docs; a42bc3b feat(client-ui) APK Open statement + MoneyFootnote. Not landed, not pushed.

API: POST /v1/client/statement-links {fromPeriod,toPeriod YYYY-MM} -> 201 {token, expiresAt}; GET /v1/public/statement-links/{token} -> text/html (200 statement, 404 one shared unavailable page, 500 failure page + log line STATEMENT_LINK_FAILED).

Contracts: new file client-statement-links.ts; descriptor gains credentialPolicy public-path-token (authChannel public-token) and optional responseMediaType text/html; generate-openapi emits text/html for success and errors of such ops. OpenAPI and frontend operations regenerated by script.

070 client_statement_links: PK user_id (one link per client, issue = upsert that retires the previous link), 32-byte HMAC only, from/to month text with order check, expires_at > created_at, unique token_hash, FK users ON DELETE RESTRICT. Additive; NOT a rollback boundary: previous release (v0.15.4) never reads it, images-only rollback works.

Consume = one UPDATE ... FROM users where token_hash matches, consumed_at null, expires_at > now, account active; ledger read and HTML render run in the same tx, so a failure rolls back and the link stays usable.

Defaults chosen: lifetime = serverConfig.emailVerification.codeTtlMs (EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_TTL_MS, the password-link lifetime, 10 min default); APK requests oldest..newest month on screen; issued months must both be months of the caller's own statement else 404; no Idempotency-Key on issue (a receipt would store the raw token); figures in whole rupees exactly like the web print view.

Erasure: G2 revokeAccess calls erasureWriteRepository.deleteStatementLinks; G3 deleteIdentity deletes rows. Coverage test classifies FK + 3 text columns. erasureSupport.populateCopies now seeds a link per client; recordFor takes an optional effectiveDate. client-erasure.md table map + pre-flight touch_statement_links updated.

DEPLOY.md: no nginx change needed (general /api/ location). Noted: boe-security-headers.conf appends Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin after the backend's no-referrer (last wins; page has no links/subresources); nginx access log records the token path (single use, short-lived). No deployment file changed.

Tests: clientStatementLinks.integration.test.ts (5: once + hash-only + A never sees B + headers/escaping; expiry + suspended; own months only/400/401; 8 concurrent opens -> exactly one 200; new link retires old + G2 erase removes link), statementLinksMigration.integration.test.ts (3: populated upgrade, previous-release writes, shape constraints), releaseUpgrade expects 070, G2 assertion in clientErasure test.
Guard proofs (tally red runs via .temp/h-statement/mutate.sh): consumed_at, expires_at, account_state, token_hash, ownership check, G2 delete, G3 delete each removed once -> its test failed.
